title: ICSI CSEET February 2027: Enrolment Applications Begin November 16, 2026!
content:
# ICSI CSEET February 2027: Enrolment Applications Begin November 16, 2026!

Ek important update hai for all aspiring Company Secretaries! The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne Company Secretary Executive Entrance Test (CSEET) February 2027 examination ke liye enrolment applications ki commencement date announce kar di hai.

Here are the key details:

*   **Enrolment Application Commencement Date:** November 16, 2026
*   **Last Date for Enrolment (without late fee):** December 15, 2026
*   **Examination Dates:** The CSEET February 2027 examination is scheduled to be held from February 1 to February 4, 2027.

Toh, make sure you mark your calendars and apply within the stipulated timelines to avoid any last-minute rush!
